items.text: Lezi ziyizohambo zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli abaphuma ezweni laseGibithe ngamabandla abo phansi kwesandla sikaMose no-Aroni.
UMose waloba ukuphuma kwabo njengezinyathelo zabo njengesiyalezo sikaJehova; lezi ziyizinkambo zabo ngohambo lwabo.
Basuka eRamsesi ngenyanga yokuqala ngosuku lweshumi nanhlanu lwenyanga yokuqala; ngangomuso emva kwephasika abantwana bakwa-Israyeli baphuma ngesandla esiphakemeyo emehlweni abo bonke abaseGibithe.
AbaseGibhithe bembela wonke amazibulo abo iNkosi eyayiwabulele phakathi kwabo; uJehova wabajezisa onkulunkulu bawo.
Basuka abantwana bakwa-Israyeli eRamesesi, bamisa inkamba eSukoti.
Basuka eSukoti, bamisa inkamba e-Etamu eseceleni kogwadule.
Basuka e-Etamu, babuyela ePhi-Hagiroti elingaphambi kweBali Sefoni, bamisa phambi kweMigidoli.
Basuka ePihagiroti, badabula ulwandle, baya ehlane, bahamba ibanga lezinsuku ezintathu ehlane lase-Etamu, bamisa eMara.
Basuka eMara, bafika e-Elimi; e-Elimi kwakukhona imithombo eyishumi nambili yamanzi namasundu angamashumi ayisithupha; bamisa khona.
Basuka e-Elimi, bamisa ngaseLwandle LwaseSkelf.
Basuka eSikelfsee, bamisa inkamba ehlane laseSini.
Basuka ehlane laseSini, bamisa inkamba eDofika.
Basuka eDofika bamisa inkamba e-Alusi.
Basuka e-Alusi bamisa inkamba eRafidimi, lapho okwakungelamanzi khona ukuthi abantu banathe.
Basuka eRefidimi, bamisa ehlane laseSinayi.
Basuka ehlane laseSinayi bamisa inkamba eKibroti Hathava.
Basuka eKibroti-Hatava bamisa inkamba eHazeroti.
Basuka eHaseroti bamisa inkamba eRitima.
Basuka eRitima bamisa inkamba eRimoni-Pheresi.
Basuka eRimoni-Pharesi bamisa inkamba eLibina.
Basuka eLibina, bamisa inkamba eRisa.
Basuka eRisa bamisa inkamba eKehelata.
Basuka eKehelatha, bamisa entabeni yaseSafer.
Basuka eNtabeni iSafer, bamisa inkamba eHarada.
Basuka eHarada bamisa inkamba eMakeloti.
Basuka eMakheloti, bamisa inkamba eThahati.
Basuka eThahati bamisa inkamba eThara.
Basuka eThara bamisa inkamba eMitka.
Basuka eMitka, bamisa eHashimona.
Basuka eHashimona bamisa inkamba eMoseroti.
Basuka eMoseroti, bamisa inkamba eBenjakani.
Basuka eBenjakani bamisa inkamba eHorihagidigadi.
Basuka eHorihagidigadi, bamisa eJotibata.
Basuka eJotibata bamisa inkamba e-Abrona.
Basuka e-Ebrona bamisa inkamba e-Esiyoni Geberi.
Basuka e-Esiyoni Geberi, bamisa ehlane laseZini eliyiKadeshi.
Basuka eKadeshi, bamisa entabeni yaseHori emaphethelweni ezwe lakwa-Edomi.
U-Aroni umpristi wenyukela entabeni yaseHori ngesiyalezo sikaJehova, wafela khona ngomnyaka wamashumi amane wokuphuma kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli eGibithe ngolokuqala lwenyanga yesihlanu.
U-Aroni wayeneminyaka eyikhulu namashumi amabili nantathu ekufeni kwakhe entabeni yaseHori.
UmKhanani, inkosi yase-Aradi, owahlala eningizimu ezweni laseKhanani, wezwa ngokufika kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Basuka entabeni yaseHori, bamisa eSalmona.
Basuka eSalmona bamisa inkamba ePhunoni.
Basuka ePunoni, bamisa inkamba e-Oboti.
Basuka e-Oboti, bamisa e-Iye Abarimi emngceleni wakwaMowabi.
Basuka e-Iyimi, bamisa inkamba eDibhon Gadi.
Basuka eDibhon Gadi, bamisa inkamba e-Alimoni-Dibilatayimi.
Basuka e-Alimoni-Dibilatayimi, bamisa ezintabeni zase-Abharimi phambi kweNebo.
Basuka ezintabeni zase-Abarimi, bamisa emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko.
Bamisa ngaseJordani, kusukela eBeti Jeshimoti kuze kufike e-Abela Shithimi emathafeni akwaMowabi.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko, wathi:
Khuluma nabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, uthi kubo: ‘Uma niwela iJordani ningena ezweni laseKhanani;

Khona-ke kumelwe nixoshe bonke abakhileyo ezweni phambi kwenu futhi nibhubhise zonke izithombe zabo eziqoshiwe futhi nibhubhise zonke izithombe zabo ezibunjiwe futhi nizidilize zonke izindawo zabo eziphakemeyo.
Kumelwe nixoshe abakhileyo ezweni futhi nihlale kulo, ngoba ngininikile izwe ukuba nilidle.

Kumelwe nihlukanise izwe ngenkatho phakathi kwezizukulwane zenu; futhi eniyomnika okuningi, ifa elikhulu, futhi omncane, ifa elincane; ifa lawo wonke umuntu kumelwe libe sendaweni lapho isabelo sakhe siwela khona; niyakudla ifa ngokwezizwe zoyihlo.
Kepha uma ningabaxoshi abakhileyo ezweni phambi kwenu; khona-ke labo enibayekayo bayakuba ngameva emehlweni enu nameva ezinhlangothini zenu, nihlushwe ezweni enihlala kulo.
Futhi kuyokwenzeka ukuthi ngiyokwenza kini njengoba bengicabanga ukwenza kubo.
